Name: Adam Grant
Description: Adam was the son of Daily Planet reporter Cat Grant and her ex-husband Joe Morgan. He was then later part of a group of children who were kidnapped by a malfunctioning Toyman robot,during which he attempted to lead the other children in an escape attempt from the villain's lair. However Toyman discovered this and quickly killed Adam.
